findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("exec").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("compile").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["run", "call", "Popen"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could lead to arbitrary code execution."
findings.hypothesis: Code injection vulnerabilities from eval/exec or dangerous subprocess calls

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could lead to arbitrary code execution.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization using pickle, yaml, marshal, or shelve modules could lead to arbitrary code execution

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file usage
 * @description Use of predictable temporary file names could lead to symlink attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/insecure-temp-file
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("NamedTemporaryFile").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("TemporaryFile").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially insecure temporary file creation. Consider using tempfile.mkstemp for more secure temporary files."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure temporary file usage could lead to symlink attacks or file race conditions

message.text: Potentially insecure temporary file creation. Consider using tempfile.mkstemp for more secure temporary files.
